name: Viscous Flow and Boundary Layers
summary: Viscous effects that govern skin-friction drag, heat transfer and flow separation: laminar and turbulent boundary layers and transition.

topics.name: Exact solutions: Couette and Poiseuille flow
Boundary-layer concept and Prandtl's boundary-layer equations
Blasius solution for the flat plate
Displacement and momentum thickness; the momentum integral equation
Laminar-turbulent transition: stability theory, Tollmien-Schlichting waves
Turbulence fundamentals: Reynolds averaging and the closure problem
Turbulent boundary layers: law of the wall and skin friction
Turbulence modelling: mixing length, k-epsilon, k-omega SST
Compressible boundary layers and aerodynamic heating
Flow control: vortex generators, suction, riblets
